 Despite dealing with an eye injury, the Turkish star has been made available for Friday's key matchup.
 Alperen Sengun to play for Rockets vs. Nuggets amid eye injury
 Alperen Sengun was initially marked as questionable to play for the Houston Rockets due to a left eye corneal abrasion. In the end, he simply shrugged off his vision issues and will be on the court to face the Denver Nuggets.
 Sengun notably took an untimely exit in the Rockets' Wednesday victory in Indiana against the Pacers after forward Aaron Nesmith hit both of his eyes on a rebound attempt.
 The presence of the star big man will be huge for Houston in going up against three-time MVP Nikola Jokic. Through 14 games so far, Sengun is averaging 21.6 points, 9.2 rebounds, and 6.8 assists per game on 54.5% shooting from the field.
 Holding a 12-4 record that puts them third in the West standings, the Rockets will look to extend their win streak over the Nuggets to continue their impressive season start.
